Shared persistent configuration (PSM/TR-181), single partition, no separate A/B. Measured 4.6 MiB used of 14 MiB capacity (36%).

notes: Partition names, allocations, and filesystem types are measured directly from the BPI-R4 reference device (fdisk/proc evidence) — see Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 3.7.1. Total allocated across all 13 partitions is 2,172 MiB, well within the 4,096 MB (4 GB) minFlashMB floor (Section 3, CRF-001) with room to spare, consistent with the 8 GB production recommendation. MAC address storage has no partition here — on this device it is derived from the serial number at boot rather than stored in flash (board-level limitation; see Section 3.7.1). Passive-slot partitions (boot_b, rootfs_b, crash_a, crash_b) have confirmed filesystems but were not independently measured in this capture (not mounted). rootfs_a's 401 MiB reflects the latest production-style measurement (build rdk8-1.0.0_20260916), superseding an earlier 383 MiB figure from a prior measurement pass.
